title: Prepare readable test values
responsibility: Builds a bounded presentation of recorded evidence without changing the original values.

inputs.name: recordedValue.value
inputs.description: The already-parsed value to present, of any JSON shape (undefined is shown as 'Not recorded'). It is only read, never rewritten, and the result keeps at most four levels, twelve items per collection and 120 values in total, with scalar text over 240 characters cut and marked shortened.
inputs.unknownReason: The renderer derives a display tree for any decoded evidence value, including absent data.

inputs.name: read.value
inputs.description: The already-parsed value at this position, of any JSON shape (undefined is shown as 'Not recorded'). It is only read, never rewritten, and objects or arrays are expanded only while the depth and budget limits allow.
inputs.unknownReason: Recursive traversal can reach any decoded property value before checking its display kind.

inputs.name: read.depth
inputs.description: The nesting level of this value: recordedValue starts at 0, and each field, list item or table cell is read one level deeper than the node that holds it. Non-scalar values at depth 4 or more become the 'Open Full recorded values to see more.' notice, while scalars at that depth are still shown.

inputs.name: read.budget
inputs.description: The counter of values still allowed, held in one object that every call for the same result shares and decrements. A call that starts with left at 0 or less returns the 'Open Full recorded values to see more.' notice, and recordedValue creates it as { left: 120 }.

outputs.name: recordedValue
outputs.description: The bounded presentation of the whole value as one of five node kinds: notice, scalar, fields, list or table. Collections show their first twelve entries and count the rest in remaining, nesting stops at four levels, and an array becomes a table only when its first twelve items are all non-array objects with scalar values and between one and eight distinct keys in total.

outputs.name: read
outputs.description: The node for this one value at the given depth, using the same five node kinds as recordedValue. Anything nested under it is read one level deeper from the same budget, and a non-scalar at depth 4 or more, or any value once the budget is spent, becomes the 'Open Full recorded values to see more.' notice.
